gaps.gap: No prevalence, motive-command or electoral counterfactual design.
The legal power does not by itself prove that any specific person satisfies the criteria.
Different mechanisms are not legally identical and should not be collapsed into one sanction category.
Judicial correction does not establish bad faith in the initial decision.
Compliance with formal due process must still be tested in each listing.
Annulment of one listing period does not prove the target was factually innocent of every alleged conduct or that all sanctions are defective.
No comparative prevalence or causal electoral design is present.
Political-motive and high-causal-effect edges remain open.
